Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q3 2022 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of INTC.
Our cloud segment grew 11% year-over-year, driven by strong enterprise demand.
We expect revenues to grow approximately 11% to 28% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q3 2022.
Customer acquisition exceeded our targets with 1579 thousand new accounts added in the quarter.
We believe the pipeline is strong, but conversion timing remains uncertain given customer budget cycles.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
Can you clarify whether the margin expansion is sustainable into next year given rising input costs?
Thank you for the question. We delivered record revenue of $40.7 billion this quarter, representing 11% year-over-year growth.
Second question - Analyst:
Are you seeing any signs of demand elasticity in your enterprise segment?
We expect revenues to grow approximately 11% to 28% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
